🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); style mixed / no clear leadership. Confirmations: extremely weak sector breadth vs concentrated 1W tech outperformance and many large-cap timing divergences support a neutral call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows strong single-stock rallies but sector-wide weakness; AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND and QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND lead on a concentrated basis.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weakest: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Materials also lag year-to-date and this week (SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND; FCX not in stock list but materials tone is weak).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentrated gains, not broad-based.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -11.72% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select healthcare and high-multiple tech/consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.15%), INTC (1W: +12.29%), QCOM (1W: +7.95%). Major divergence present: multiple large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatch (MSFT, NOW, AMAT, PFE) — MAJOR DIVERGENCE, tactically watch for trend breaks rather than assuming continuation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and concentrated: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -0.21% — strong single-stock rallies but overall tech internals remain weak.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft across majors: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -1.78% and no clear financial leadership to push a risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Under pressure: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -5.60% — defensive names failing to lead.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective energy and semiconductor exposure (CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to stretched software/consumer-discretionary losers (ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -11.72% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed — leadership narrow, so be selective and monitor sentiment-driven flows.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through on heavy 1W moves. BEARISH: AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum could extend.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: Energy is the sole positive sector; watch CVX/XOM/VLO). BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary — trailing sector returns and heavy names suggest continued pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch confirmation of 1W breakouts/reversals rather than specific price calls: AMD sustaining post-1W strength confirms zone continuation; NVDA reclaim above its 1W high would reduce downside risk; AMGN/NVS failing short-term support implies further downside.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (+80): Qualcomm headline; QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming. JNJ (+60): M&A talks; JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — bullish news but near-term price weakness, watch for follow-through. CVX (+60): supply shock headlines; CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (-55): trial headline; AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by sharp price decline. INTC (-45): headline on insider selling; INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from strong 1W rally, watch for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (MSFT, NOW, AMAT, PFE) and mixed news sentiment (QCOM/INTC headlines) — monitor for trend breaks and confirmatory flows.
